correctness.rationale: Specified three-community genuine triadic terms and symmetric opinion coupling leave the synchronous plane invariant; on negative-opinion sign region it has xdot=x[-d0−d1 y+q x(1−x)] and ydot=x−y. At s,w parametrization equilibrium has trace zero and determinant w²>0, with a lower saddle. The explicitly normalized real Hopf coordinates yield exact first Lyapunov coefficient [4s−1−2(1−2s)w²]/[8s(1−2s)²w²], independently reproduced by symbolic derivatives. At (s,w)=(1/4,1/2) and (1/3,1/2), l1=−2 and +9/4 and trace crossing speeds +1/8 and −7/9. Classical nondegenerate planar Hopf gives attracting versus repelling small cycles on the invariant synchronous plane, and IFT preserves both for sufficiently small positive pairwise transmission. No transverse/global stability claimed.
